name: Joaddan
title: Mother of King Amaziah of Judah
summary: Joaddan (also spelled Jehoaddan) was a woman from Jerusalem who was the mother of King Amaziah of Judah. She is mentioned as the wife of King Joash of Judah. Her significance in the Bible is primarily linked to her role as queen mother in the kingdom of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as the mother of Amaziah in the Books of Kings
keyEvents.description: Joaddan from Jerusalem is mentioned as the mother of King Amaziah when he became king over Judah, at 25 years old.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as the mother of Amaziah in the Books of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In the parallel account in Second Chronicles, Joaddan from Jerusalem is again identified as Amaziah's mother.

keyEvents.title: Amaziah's accession to the throne
keyEvents.description: Amaziah, son of Joaddan, became king over Judah after his father Joash was murdered by his servants. He did what was right in the Lord's eyes, but not with a whole heart.

keyEvents.title: Joash's death and Amaziah's succession
keyEvents.description: After King Joash, the husband of Jehoaddan, was killed in a conspiracy, their son Amaziah took the throne of Judah.
